scope: AI4I_CURRENT_STATE_ONLY; development-only post-hoc extension; no independent final test
population: Original 5600 train rows; 1200 reused-validation and 1200 excluded test never scored/fitted
base_models: All 40 supervised historical configurations; raw anomaly scores kept separate

new_candidates.triples: equal weighting of all unordered triples of 16 non-dummy families; best configuration per family selected inside each outer-train (560)
new_candidates.committees: top2/top3/top5/top8/top16, uniform and reciprocal-rank weights, using inner ranking
new_candidates.stacking: top3/top5/top8 from inner ranking; LogisticRegression C=0.1/1/10, class_weight=None/balanced; base inputs are historical inner-OOF predictions; final meta fit excludes outer-held. Threshold learned on meta training scores, not an independent meta-OOF sample; outer evaluation measures that procedure.
new_candidates.anomaly_unions: RF AVISO OR top 1%/3%/5% inner-normal-proxy anomaly tail for all ten detectors; rarety diagnostic, not calibrated probability

policies: A: threshold learned inside outer-train for cost, inner recall >=0.76
C: fixed CRITICA >=0.70 diagnostic, not replacement for AVISO
selection: inner score only; deterministic cost, FN, name tie break. Report nested procedure separately from post-hoc outer best. All previously explored folds remain development evidence.
uncertainty: paired stratified bootstrap 2000 fixed OOF predictions; conditional/descriptive only; no correction for thousands of searches
resources: serial CPU, BLAS/OpenMP one thread; no original base refits; no new dependencies; no API/model promotion
feature_audit: source hash and exact memberships; train-only profile; leakage columns excluded; physical derivations, subgroup errors and disagreement diagnostics
